items.question: Which deities and marker are assigned to the northwest corner?
premises: The northwest corner is the specified locus.
Āditya is located in the northwest corner.
Vāyu and Bhallātaka are likewise located there.
items.inference: Āditya, Vāyu, and Bhallātaka occupy the northwest corner.
uncertainties: Whether bhallātaka denotes the plant, a totemic marker, or a specific deity-form in this context.
items.plain_english: In the northwest corner are Āditya, Vāyu, and likewise Bhallātaka.
